description: Search the ready-made 3D model catalogue by name, category and tag. The default catalogue is a few hundred public-domain (CC0) props, free to use commercially. Faster and more predictable than generating when a common object will do: search first, generate what you cannot find.

catalogue.description: A different catalogue URL to search instead of the default.

limit.description: How many results to return. Default 12.

query.description: Words to match against names, categories and tags. Omit to browse.

name: search_models
title: Search the ready-made model library
